description: This file contains unit tests for the GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer, which checks for the presence of [Alias] attributes on various types and methods in C# code, specifically targeting Orleans grain interfaces, serializable classes, structs, and records. The tests verify that diagnostics are correctly triggered or suppressed based on the presence of [Alias] attributes and the type of code element.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzerTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer, ensuring it correctly identifies code elements that need [Alias] attributes and those that already have them.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Checks that the provided code triggers the expected number of diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Checks that the provided code does not trigger any diagnostics from the analyzer.
